pr.body:
## Problem and value

Agreed CSS P0 from [#1068](https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify/issues/1068#issuecomment-6379381498). The English Explainer toolbar overflows a 320px viewport and obstructs Style/Export.

Wrap the toolbar at <=760px and anchor menus to the wrapping container. The runtime delta against inspected dev `10b4dd5c5f2264baa315ee65a9b4cc23c13ea5f0` remains one media rule. No JavaScript, dependency, release-identity or P1/P2 feature change.

## AI assistance and accountability

- AI use: implementation, investigation, tests and writing assistance using Codex; exact model identifier unavailable.
- Accountable contributor: @BlueboxC.
- Origin: reproducible inspection following the bilingual comparison in #1068.
- [ ] I reviewed the submitted changes and explanation, understand their impact, and can answer questions about them.

This remains a draft. Personal human-review confirmation is pending.

## Stability impact

Shared Explainer reader CSS; desktop >760px and existing print behavior remain preserved. The existing browser fixture checks observable containment, Style/Export operation, Escape/focus restoration and hidden print controls. It does not freeze layout coordinates or introduce a parallel test framework.

## Current verification

Head [`cd50794`](https://github.com/BlueboxC/archify/commit/cd50794b794fc9f6ec4c9914dee78df0b7fddde3) merges the inspected dev revision above into this branch. Compared with that dev tree, only the CSS rule, its existing-file regression and canonical ZIP differ.

- Real Chrome: dev reproduces the narrow-toolbar failure; candidate passes **all nine Explainer browser tests**, including **24 locale/style/viewport combinations** (en/zh-CN; clean/editorial/product/swiss; 320/390/1440), keyboard/menu containment and print checks.
- `npm run test:generated` passes.
- Canonical ZIP rebuilt from the combined source with official Node22.23.2 / bundled zlib1.3.1-e00f703. Apache licensing and historical MIT notices from current dev are preserved.
- [Final-head CI](https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify/actions/runs/40232925326) has completed: **19 successful checks, 2 skips, zero failures**, including both full-regression shards, both browser shards, Windows portability on Node22/24, three-platform package smokes, Node18/20/22/24 tests, WebM decode and ZIP freshness. The local refresh used focused checks; these separate CI results supply the platform qualification. Maintainer acceptance and personal human approval remain pending.
- [Earlier 144-case / 960-capture comparison](https://github.com/BlueboxC/archify/commit/ad60fc94cd4038e2136a8c05203091e836eb94b6) remains historical evidence at its recorded revisions.

## Visual evidence and generated artifacts

The browser regression is reproducible from this head and compares the same document, locale, style and viewport. Perceptual human review is pending. Gallery pages do not embed the Explainer reader change, so no unrelated Gallery refresh is included. No release, deployment or repository-generation benchmark is claimed.

BlueboxC
